title: cacalia angustifolia var. texana
intro: Cacalia angustifolia var. texana, commonly known as Texan wild indigo, is a perennial plant that belongs to the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms of respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of Cacalia angustifolia var. texana include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which may contribute to its medicinal properties.
